dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would any fur drop into the dishes?

dialogues.speaker: Nefedov
dialogues.text: Of course not. Our chefs clean up any loose fur before stepping up to the plate, and we do our best to ensure that nothing falls into the dishes while we cook...

dialogues.speaker: Nefedov
dialogues.text: If you... do encounter something of the sort, you can get our waiter to clear the dish, and we'll make you a fresh one.
